title: User Startup folder
whyItMatters: Shortcuts in this folder start programs at sign-in. Their names reveal tools that may still run and hold sessions on the machine.
source: Microsoft Learn: per-user Startup folder at %APPDATA%/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup
notes: Names only: no recursion and no shortcut target is resolved. The machine-wide Startup folder under ProgramData is not covered.

steps: Open the Startup folder path named in the plan in File Explorer.
Note which program each shortcut starts before you delete it.
Delete the shortcuts you no longer need and empty the Recycle Bin.
cleanup.risk: Removes those shortcuts, so the programs stop starting at sign-in. The programs themselves stay installed and keep their data.
